take.en: Open office runtime for people and agents — sheets, docs, slides, and tables with one Facade API in the browser and on Node.

explanation.en: Univer is an open-source Office SDK you embed in your own product. Canvas rendering, a formula engine, and a plugin architecture cover spreadsheets, documents, presentations, bases, and boards. The same stack runs headless on Node so agents can create, inspect, and edit workbooks without a UI. Companion projects add agent CLI, DeepSeek Harness plugins, and OpenClaw tools so humans and agents share the same files with reviewable drafts.

why.en: Founders building finance, ops, and BI products still glue Excel parsers to chat agents and hope the grid stays coherent. Univer is the missing surface: embed real editable office UIs, let agents hit the same APIs server-side, then let people review worktree drafts before merge. That is product infrastructure, not another coding TUI.

howItWorks.en: Install the core packages (or a preset), register plugins for sheets/docs/UI, and drive workbooks through the Facade API. For agents, use headless Node processing or the Univer CLI / harness plugins to create and edit content, then verify with inspection or screenshots. Live collab and worktrees sit on the Web SDK when you need shared review.

different.en: Not a hosted Google Sheets clone and not a file converter. You own the runtime inside your app, isomorphic browser+Node, plugin-shaped so you ship only what you need. Complementary to scrape/PDF tools and coding agents — this is the office harness they write into.
